data.text: PUZZLE DUNGEON: 9 TRIALS
BACK TO TUTORIAL
SHOP: PUSH TO BUY
DIG AT CRACKED TILES
QUICK! GRAB A MUSHROOM FIRST
RACE TO THE VAULT DOOR!
SLIDE TO THE ISLAND
LURE CHASERS INTO THE BOULDER LANES
PARK THE BOULDER ON THE PLATE. TREES STOP IT
LEAVE AND RETURN TO RESET THE ROOM
SINK THE BOULDERS TO CROSS
PUSH THE EAST ONE FIRST. LEAVE TO RESET
ONE WAY BELTS
GHOSTS FEAR LIGHT. THE MOON GATE OPENS AT NIGHT
BRING A FISH TO THE SHRINE. NO JUMPING!
SWITCH TRIAL: SEVEN ROOMS, ONE WAY DOWN
BLUE STANDS, RED SLEEPS. A SWITCH SWAPS THEM
PUSH THE OTHER SWITCH TO SWAP BACK
THE PATROL FLIPS THE SWITCH. WAIT IN THE POCKET
PUSH THE CLOCK, THEN RUN: 8 SECONDS
TOO SLOW? THE PLAZA SHOP SELLS MUSHROOMS
THE GAP SLIDES DOWN ONE STEP PER PUSH
PRESS THE BUTTONS IN NUMBER ORDER. A SKIP RESETS THEM
LOWER ALL THREE BLUE BLOCKS. SOME SWITCHES FLIP A NEIGHBOR
ROLL A BOULDER INTO A SWITCH, THEN HIDE BEHIND THE BLUE WALL
OUT OF BOULDERS IN THE LAST ROOM? WALK TWO ROOMS UP AND RETURN
MASTER OF SWITCHES! LEAVE AND RETURN TO RESET
THE VAULT: THREE KEYS
MASTER OF GIMMICKS!
B2F: THE DEEPER TRIAL
